status: visual ownership review only; inventory unchanged Gate 8 lower-head reinforcement against the approved V5 exterior repartition; no cutting, redesign, STL, G-code, print, or aluminum release

ownership_contact.rule: Classify each whole connected reinforcement component from its actual contact vertices against the approved retained and cassette source facets. Contacts only retained => retained; only cassette => cassette; both => crosses seam; neither => unclassified. Never split a component in this review.

review_holds: This review duplicates existing Gate 8 reinforcement components for visibility and classification; it does not edit the source lower-face meshes.
Every reinforcement component remains whole. A component touching both approved ownership regions is red and requires a later explicit redesign.

Components with less than 50 percent reinforcement-tagged surface area are preserved in the separate INTEGRATED_SHELL_PLUS_REINFORCEMENT collection and hidden by default because they include substantial shell geometry.
Magenta means the component has no verified exterior contact under the configured geometric rule; it is not silently assigned.
The approved V5 exterior seam and all exterior source facets remain unchanged.
Upper head, ears, eyes, connectors, glow inserts, rear_base, and aluminum geometry remain unchanged.
No reinforcement is added, cut, shortened, deleted, unioned, or transferred in this review.
No STL or G-code is exported, and nothing is released for printing or aluminum fabrication.
